item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
Issued at 02:05 AM 12 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CamarinesNorte(Capalonga, SantaElena), #CamarinesSur(DelGallego, Ragay, Lupi, Sipocot, Goa, Calabanga, SanJose, Presentacion, Caramoan) and #Catanduanes within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesNorte(Mercedes, Basud, SanLorenzoRuiz, Daet, Talisay, SanVicente, Vinzons, Labo, Paracale, JosePanganiban), #CamarinesSur(Siruma, Tinambac, Lagonoy and Garchitorena) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
